screening_decisions.reason: Adults with frozen shoulder randomized to intra-articular steroids, mobilisations, ice, or no treatment; all taught pendular exercises. Manual therapy/exercise present and compared against other/no intervention.
Observational incidence/management in general practice; not a randomized trial of manual therapy or exercise for adhesive capsulitis.
Educational/methods article on joint mobilization principles; not an RCT/quasi-RCT in adhesive capsulitis.

Open RCT of arthrographic distension with steroid added to physical therapies versus physical therapies alone; does not compare manual therapy/exercise vs a different manual/exercise or control—tests steroid add-on.
Methodological review of RCT reporting; not a clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized controlled trial in idiopathic adhesive capsulitis assessing deep transverse friction massage and capsular stretching (manual therapy/exercise).
Randomized comparison of two supervised exercise programs in frozen shoulder with pain/ROM outcomes—eligible exercise-based intervention.
Randomized multiple-treatment trial comparing mobilization techniques in frozen shoulder syndrome (manual therapy).
Population described as chronic peri-arthritis; randomization not stated; exercise-only focus unclear for adhesive capsulitis specifically.
Randomized pilot comparing AP vs PA glides (Kaltenborn grade III) in adhesive capsulitis—manual therapy technique comparison.
Population prevalence/impact study; not an intervention RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
Multiple-subject case report; not a randomized or quasi-randomized trial.
Placebo-controlled RCT (intra-articular steroid, supervised physiotherapy, combination, or saline) with home exercise; includes physiotherapy versus placebo/different interventions.
Randomized trial of manual therapy + directed exercise versus sham ultrasound following joint distension in adhesive capsulitis—tests adjunct physiotherapy effect.
Questionnaire responsiveness study; not an intervention RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
Comparative clinical series of acupuncture and physical therapy; non-randomized.
Systematic review/cost-effectiveness; not a primary RCT.

Comparison of anterior versus posterior glide mobilisation techniques for internal rotation in adhesive capsulitis; therapy comparison consistent with manual therapy focus (randomization not explicit but likely).
Methodological study on outcome reporting bias; not an AC treatment RCT.
Title indicates heating modalities for frozen shoulder; abstract mismatch and modality-only focus (not manual therapy/exercise).
Randomized clinical trial comparing corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, and combination therapy in frozen shoulder; includes a physiotherapy arm.
Randomized trial: Cyriax (deep friction massage + mobilization) vs conventional PT modalities plus stretching/home exercise in adhesive capsulitis.
Natural history prospective study; not an intervention RCT.
Meta-analysis methodology (heterogeneity) paper; not a clinical trial.
Methodological guidance on reporting biases; not a clinical trial.
Long-term prospective natural history; not a randomized trial.
Random allocation to mobilization + active exercises versus exercises alone in painfully stiff shoulders/adhesive capsulitis—manual therapy plus exercise vs exercise.

Randomized four-arm study in adhesive capsulitis including a physical therapy modalities arm versus injections and control; includes a PT arm relevant to exercise/manual therapy domain (details of PT components unclear).
EMG study during exercises; not an RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
Comparative study for chronic shoulder pain (mixed etiologies), not adhesive capsulitis-specific.
Randomized trial comparing local corticosteroid injection versus physiotherapy in adhesive capsulitis.
Cochrane methods chapter; not a clinical trial.
Retrospective study of painful stiff shoulder; not randomized.
Randomized controlled study comparing Mulligan’s versus Maitland’s mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis.
Cochrane methods chapter on presenting results; not a clinical trial.
Population-based consultation patterns; not an intervention trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized iontophoresis vs phonophoresis in ‘shoulder periarthritis’ (modality-only; diagnosis ambiguous); not manual therapy/exercise-focused.
Prospective randomized observer-blind trial comparing steroid injection, physiotherapy, or both in painful stiff shoulder—likely relevant to adhesive capsulitis and includes physiotherapy arm.

Double-blind RCT: electroacupuncture or interferential electrotherapy plus shoulder exercises versus no treatment in frozen shoulder; exercise is a core component of active arms (adjunct modalities present).
Randomized trial comparing physical therapy plus ibuprofen versus ibuprofen alone in adhesive capsulitis—tests added effect of physiotherapy.
Randomized control trial assessing end-range mobilization techniques plus exercises versus exercises/ultrasound—manual therapy emphasis.
Randomized clinical trial comparing anterior versus posterior glide joint mobilization for external rotation in adhesive capsulitis (JOSPT 2007).
Randomized placebo-controlled trial of intra-articular triamcinolone and/or standardized physiotherapy versus placebo—includes a physiotherapy-only arm.
Randomized comparison of manipulation under anesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy for adhesive capsulitis—includes manual therapy/physiotherapy arms.
Systematic review; not a primary RCT.
Cochrane methods chapter on meta-analysis; not a clinical trial.
Randomized controlled study of joint mobilization versus self-exercises for limited glenohumeral mobility arising from adhesive capsulitis.
Prospective, systematically allocated (quasi-randomized) clinical trial comparing chiropractic manipulation + exercise vs mobilization + exercise in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized controlled trial comparing high-grade vs low-grade mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis.
Pilot randomized, single-blind study testing added passive joint mobilization versus home-care only following corticosteroid injection in adhesive capsulitis.
